title: Encoding a binary quadratic form
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $w\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Define a Boolean-valued function on a disjoint union of an index set of size $2^n$ and one of size $2^{n^2}$ as follows: at an index corresponding to $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, its value is the Boolean encoding of $\sum_{i=1}^n w_i x_i$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$; at an index corresponding to a binary matrix $A=(A_{ij})_{1\le i,j\le n}$, its value is the Boolean encoding of $\sum_{i,j=1}^n w_iw_jA_{ij}$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is an element of the binary cube of dimension $n$
